messages:
maria_pm: Heads-up — we need a quick alignment on slotting and rollback criteria for the upcoming private-pilot launch. Customer wants guaranteed prewarm slots + a canary rollout.
alex_p: what are the exact asks from customer? number of slots, latency SLA?
maria_pm: they want 10 reserved slots for peak windows, 95th pct latency <= 180ms for text-gen, and a canary holding 5% of traffic for 24h.
sam_runtime: 95th 180ms is tight for the model at full concurrency. We can get close with prewarm + smaller batch sizes, but unit cost will jump.
leo_infra: to guarantee 10 reserved slots across zones we'll need capacity reservations in Dedicated pool, and a cross-zone failover plan. That means adjusting autoscaler min to keep nodes warm. Ops impact: ~+2 GPUs reserved on weekdays.
asha_security: anything in the canary that touches PII or customer data requires scoped audit logs and KMS isolation. We need clear acceptance for data residency during the 24h canary.
jen_devex: docs/console needs a per-tenant toggle and a visible canary metric card (latency, error-rate, token-cost). I can mock the UI if you give me the metric names.
maria_pm: proposed rollout plan: 0) reserve 10 slots 1 week prelaunch 1) canary 5% -> 24h 2) ramp to 50% -> 6h 3) full. Rollback triggers: latency 95th > 220ms for >10min OR error-rate > 1%  OR client visible quality regression flagged by evals.
alex_p: can we tighten the latency trigger? 220 feels high. But we also need to avoid false positives from transient spikes. Maybe 95th > 200ms sustained 10m?
sam_runtime: 200ms makes sense operationally. Also add slow-start protection: if we see CPU/GPU saturation > 85% for 5m, don't ramp further and trigger an ops page.
leo_infra: agreed. For capacity we should codify the slot reservation: "reserved_slots": 10, "zone_spread": true. Also require a prewarm script: `./prewarm --model X --slots 10 --duration 1h` in staging.
maria_pm: can we capture those as succinct checklist items for launch readiness?
jen_devex: I'll add the metric card names: `rtd.p95.latency`, `rtd.error_rate`, `rtd.gpu_util` and a cost delta card `rtd.token_cost_delta`.
asha_security: KMS isolation requirement: canary traffic must use customer-KMS for at-rest keys and audit logs enabled to S3 for 30d. Also threat model quick-check before canary.
sam_runtime: ops playbook snippets — rollback command: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --tenant TENANT --to canary` and an emergency fallback: route traffic to smaller quantized model `model-x-q4` if quality acceptable.
alex_p: ok decision points: 1) SLA thresholds: p95 <= 180ms ideal, trigger at 200ms sustained 10m. 2) Error rate trigger: >1% sustained 5m. 3) GPU saturation trigger: >85% 5m. 4) Reserved slots: 10, prewarm 1h. 5) Security: KMS + 30d audit logs. 6) Devex: dashboard cards added. 7) Rollback tools: redwoodctl and quantized fallback.
maria_pm: can engineering owners ack and confirm capacity/cost delta? @sam_runtime @leo_infra
sam_runtime: ack. We'll run a staging prewarm test tomorrow 09:00 PT and post results. Expect ~+18% token latency cost at peak with reserved slots.
leo_infra: ack. I'll file infra change PR to set min nodes and add reservations, will include estimated $/mo in the PR description.
en: deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging/prewarm-test at 2024-08-11T16:00:00Z by sam_runtime :rocket:
jen_devex: I'll sketch the canary card and send a quick screenshot by EOD.
maria_pm: great. I'll synthesize this into the launch checklist and publish to the customer channel. If anyone has objections to the triggers/plan, raise them before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
